regime_context: The CSI 300 thematic detector shows Industrial Metals in a durable, broad-based uptrend (breadth 0.92, durability 0.86) with no crowding. Absolute-trend gate historically failed to reduce drawdown in this market, and cross-sectional momentum has no forward edge, so any lean is speculative.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: The theme is the top-ranked, eligible leader with the highest durability and near-perfect breadth, suggesting sustained participation that isn't yet crowded. I lean overweight conditional on the trend holding, but the detector's own backtest here (gate_helps=false, rank-IC ~0) demands low conviction; this is a trend-continuation bet, not a return forecast.
evidence: rank #1 with score 1.49, wide margin over #2
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate historically reduced to a mean-reverting whipsaw on this market; Industrial Metals is a cyclicals mean-reversion candidate, and the top momentum rank itself carries no verified predictive power. Macro uncertainty (AI narrative noise, geopolitics) could easily redirect flows.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS underperforms CSI 300 by more than 2% on a rolling 20-day basis before 2026-09-04
